lines.en: I give Rika a call to find that she's in the mood to “do something” this morning. But, not being well-versed in “doing things,” I struggle to think of anything but getting coffee.
lines.zh: 我给 Rika 打了个电话，发现她今天早上很有兴致「做点什么」。可我对「做点什么」并不在行，绞尽脑汁也想不出别的，只能去买咖啡。

lines.en: She jumps at the chance for this because it gives her the rare opportunity to visit Rin at work without being yelled at since it “wasn't her idea.”
lines.zh: 她立刻抓住了这个机会，因为这给了她一个难得的机会，可以在上班的时候去看望 Rin 又不会被骂——毕竟「不是她的主意」。

lines.en: Of course, Rika wastes no time in rushing the counter and pointing out Rin to me as if I had no idea she worked here before then proceeding to talk about how great she is.
lines.zh: 当然，Rika 一刻也没耽误，冲到柜台前把 Rin 指给我看，仿佛我压根不知道她在这儿上班似的，接着便开始大谈她有多棒。

lines.en: Rin does nothing apart from standing there like a verbal punching bag, absorbing her mother's kind words like jabs from the fists of Mike Tyson.
lines.zh: Rin 什么也没做，只是站在那儿当个语言沙包，把她母亲的那些好话当成迈克·泰森拳头下的重击一样承受着。

lines.en: But instead of being knocked out, she just...
She walks away. Meaning that Rika and I now have to wait for someone else to come to the counter if we actually want coffee today.
lines.zh: 她走开了。这意味着如果我和 Rika 今天真想喝上咖啡，就得等别人来柜台。

lines.en: Thankfully, Haruka shows up shortly after and serves us. But not after providing a brief reminder that we are not allowed to torment her employees at work.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，Haruka 很快就出现了，接待了我们。不过在那之前，她先简短地提醒了我们一句：不许在她上班的时候折磨她的员工。

lines.en: Rika apologizes, but I do not because I am innocent.
lines.zh: Rika 道了歉，而我没有——因为我是无辜的。

lines.en: Then, after receiving our drinks, we make our way over to a table near the window and spend the rest of the morning discussing the right and wrong times to embarrass your children.
lines.zh: 拿到饮料后，我们走到靠窗的一张桌子旁，用剩下的整段时间讨论了「让孩子难堪的正确时机与错误时机」。

lines.en: And as we exit the store, I silently hope that this discussion will never become relevant to me.
lines.zh: 走出店门时，我暗自希望这场讨论永远都不要跟我自己扯上关系。
